title: Why Every Small Business Needs Same Day Highlight Clips
excerpt: The event is over, but online, it's just starting. Here's why posting highlight clips the same day changes everything for small brands.
body:
You spent months planning the summit, launch or concert. The room was full, the energy was real. And then… you post about it next week, when everyone has moved on. Sound familiar?

Attention has a half life

Event content spikes on the day and decays fast. A highlight clip posted while the excitement is still trending picks up the hashtag momentum, the attendees' shares and the FOMO of people who missed it. The same clip a week later starts from zero.

What a same day clip actually does

  • Shows future clients and sponsors that your events are worth attending, live proof, not promises
  • Gives attendees shareable moments they'll post themselves, tagging your brand
  • Extends one event into a week of content: teaser, live clip, highlight, recap carousel
Your event isn't finished when the lights go off. It's finished when the content lands.

How I shoot for same day delivery

When you book event coverage with me, same day highlight clips are built into the workflow: I shoot with the edit in mind, cut during breaks, and deliver vertical clips ready for social before the day ends, so your post goes up while people are still talking about it.
